story_type: high-altitude jet in a pressure suit
hook: Above 64,000 feet, blood boils. He flies higher.
narration: Above sixty-four thousand feet, your blood can boil. This pilot flies higher than that.
Stu Broce flies NASA's ER-2, as one of only four pilots in the world.
He suits up like an astronaut, then rides out to the plane in a van.
The ER-2 gets off the ground fast, with a huge wing and a very powerful engine.
It can climb above seventy thousand feet, carrying science instruments over the weather.
[short pause] The suit keeps pressure on his body. Up here, without it, he could not live.
outcome: Stu Broce took the ER-2 above seventy thousand feet, where the sky turns dark blue and Earth curves away.
title: Flying so high his blood could boil
description:
NASA ER-2 pilot Stuart Broce suits up and flies to 70,000 feet to collect atmospheric data for NASA's SEAC4RS airborne science mission, in a 2013 NASA Ames video.

Footage: NASA Ames video, via the NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/ARC-20131028-AAV3505-Pilot-Soars-to-70000-Ft
